question: Who was honoured by the Polly Umrigar Award of B.C.C.I. in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jasprit Bumrah.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s fast bowling sensation** Jasprit Bumrah **will receive the prestigious** Polly Umrigar Award** for the **best international cricketer (2018-19)** at the BCCI Annual Awards (Naman) held in Mumbai, in January 2020. 
 
• The world no.1 ODI bowler made his **Test debut during India’s tour of South Africa in January 2018** and hasn’t looked back since.
 
• He picked up a **five-wicket haul in South Africa, England, Australia, and the West Indies** and became the first and only Asian bowler to achieve the feat.
 
• He played a stellar role in the historic 2-1 Test series win in Australia that** helped India retain the Border Gavaskar Trophy.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Polly Umrigar Award**

 
 
• ​Polly Umrigar was an **Indian cricketer who mostly played first-class cricket.**
 
• It is an annual award **given by BCCI.**
 
• **Virat Kohli also won it 5 times,** the most by any Indian cricketer.
